supplements: device-feasibility-2026-10-09 (2026-10-09-device-matrix.json); covers parent AC2 (trigger-to-ready and end-of-input-to-durable-save measured separately) and the accessibility part of AC1 that the first session skipped
collector: maintainer operated the phone and screen-recorded each batch; coordinator timed the recordings frame by frame on the Mac

method.latency: iOS screen recording (Control Center > Screen Record, 1206x2622, nominal 60 fps, variable frame rate). Frames were extracted one-to-one with their presentation timestamps (ffmpeg -fps_mode passthrough, showinfo pts) and classified by region brightness; every detected frame was confirmed by eye on a 60 fps contact strip. Resolution is one frame (16.7 ms). The trigger is the first frame in which the pressed control is highlighted (touch-down); iOS screen recording does not draw touches, so touch-up is not observable and all latencies are measured from touch-down, which makes them upper bounds on release-to-ready.
method.ready: two frames are reported per trial: the first frame in which the app's content is visible inside the system launch animation (app_first_visible) and the first frame in which the animation has finished and the frame is identical to the steady state (app_fully_drawn). The conservative number is app_fully_drawn.
method.durable_save: CaptureProbe commits the entry record before its first frame: in every trial the first visible app frame already shows the entry with Result: Saved, so for the Control Center path end-of-input-to-durable-save is not separable from trigger-to-ready and is bounded by it. For voice the AudioProbe Stop button was used: Stop reports Saved only after AVAudioRecorder has finished and the file has been read back (docs/validation/audio-probe.md, Finalization), so the first frame showing the Saved line is the durable point.
method.accessibility: VoiceOver with Caption Panel on; the spoken text was read from the caption band of the screen recording. Keyboard navigation needs a hardware keyboard, which the maintainer does not own.

private_evidence_reference: ~/.ohand-private-evidence/p09/latency/ (four screen recordings named ScreenRecording_10-09-2026 <HH-MM-SS>_1.MP4, extracted strips under frames/, per-frame timestamp lists under raw/) and ~/.ohand-private-evidence/p09/accessibility/vo/ (caption-band crops cap-NNNN.png at 2 fps and the de-duplicated tiles tile-0..4.png). P02_trigger_to_ready.doc: docs/validation/capture-entry.md, 'Needs a physical device' (observed latency on cold and warm launch)
P02_trigger_to_ready.artifacts: latency/ScreenRecording_10-09-2026 22-18-54_1.MP4 (six cold trials), latency/ScreenRecording_10-09-2026 22-19-54_1.MP4 (five warm trials), frames/strip-cold-t4.png, frames/strip-warm-t4.png, frames/cold-entries.png, frames/warm-entries.png
P02_trigger_to_ready.procedure: Cold: CaptureProbe force-quit from the app switcher, Control Center opened, the capture control pressed, entry waited for, repeated. Warm: CaptureProbe opened once and sent to the background without force-quit, then the same presses. Each committed entry's text was read from the recording: all six cold trials show 'Entry: controlIntent, cold launch' and all five warm trials show 'warm launch'.
P02_trigger_to_ready.durable_save: In all eleven trials the entry with 'Result: Saved' is present in the first visible app frame; the record file is written before the first frame is drawn. End-of-input-to-durable-save for this entry path is therefore at most press_to_first_visible.
P02_trigger_to_ready.locked_device: Not measurable by this method: iOS stops the screen recording when the device locks. The first record's P02 result stands: from the lock screen the control opened the app only after the passive Face ID unlock, with protected data already available, so this entry mechanism does not capture while locked.

P03_end_of_input_to_save.doc: docs/validation/audio-probe.md, Finalization and 'Needs a physical device'
P03_end_of_input_to_save.procedure: Five cycles of Start, about three seconds of speech, Stop. Stop is wired to touchUpInside (ios/AudioProbe/Sources/AppDelegate.swift). Per trial: the first frame with the Stop button highlighted (touch-down), the first frame showing 'Saved: <duration>, <bytes>, protection ...', and the first frame of the highlight fading.
P03_end_of_input_to_save.note: Recordings were 3.25 to 3.9 s. The finish callback arrived within the bound every time (a timeout would have reported partial, not saved). Saved appears 50 to 67 ms before the button's unhighlight animation starts in every trial, which is consistent with the synchronous stopAndClose running inside the touch-up action; release lies between touch-down and the Saved frame, so release-to-durable-save is at most the touch-down figure.

P04_time_to_transcript.result: Measured in the first record (0.15 to 0.32 s for the fixture, offline); not repeated.

P07_accessibility.artifacts: accessibility/vo/tile-0.png through tile-4.png (caption-band crops from latency/ScreenRecording_10-09-2026 22-27-08_1.MP4)

results.5_voiceover_captureprobe_button: Pass. With an entry present the caption reads 'Review in management app, Button, , Opens the management app. Only this entry's identifier is sent.' With no entry the same control reads '... dimmed, Button ...', matching its disabled state.
results.5_voiceover_captureprobe_text: 'Capture Probe, Heading'; the description and the capture identifier line are read in full ('Capture ID: ... Entry: controlIntent, ...').
results.5_voiceover_tauri_headings: Pass. Rotor set to Headings reached 'ohand-tauri-probe, Oh And Tauri Probe, Heading', 'Native Round-Trip Test, Heading level 2' and 'Received captures, Heading level 2'.
results.5_voiceover_tauri_summary: Read as 'Captures received: 6. Handoffs rejected: 1.' Whether it announces automatically when the count changes (live status) was not exercised in this session.
results.5_voiceover_tauri_identifiers: Pass. 'Received capture identifiers, CB02991B-DB2F-4F B6-BE97-...' followed by each identifier read in full, digit groups spelled out.
results.5_voiceover_tauri_controls: 'Hello from Tauri, Text field, Double tap to edit.' and 'Echo from Rust: Hello from Tauri' were reachable by swiping.

headline_findings: Control Center capture: median 0.94 s cold and 0.88 s warm from touch-down to the fully drawn entry (max 1.15 s over eleven trials); the entry is already durable in the first visible frame.
Voice: Stop to durable Saved is 0.15 to 0.18 s from touch-down over five trials.
Both are far inside the 3 s performance threshold in docs/validation/m1-protocol.md.
VoiceOver: the handoff button, headings, summary and identifiers in both probes are announced as specified.
Hardware keyboard navigation remains untested (no keyboard available).
